about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Mexican Sopa de Fideo Toasted Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Thin noodles toasted golden, then simmered in a smoky tomato and garlic broth until soft and comforting.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pot and fry the broken noodles for 4 minutes, stirring, until deep golden.
Blend the tomatoes, garlic, onion and chipotle until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and cook for 3 minutes, until it darkens and thickens.
Add the stock, oregano and salt, bring to the boil, then simmer for 8 minutes, until the noodles are tender.
Ladle into bowls and top with avocado and a squeeze of lime.
notes: The noodles keep absorbing broth, so add a splash of water when reheating.
Toast the noodles evenly, as pale pieces taste floury.

recipes.title: Mexican Caldo de Pollo Chicken and Vegetable Soup
recipes.summary: A clear, golden home-style chicken soup with corn, carrot, zucchini and potato, served with rice, coriander and lime.
steps: Put the chicken, water, onion, garlic and salt in a large pot and bring to a gentle boil, until the surface just trembles.
Simmer for 20 minutes, skimming any foam, until the chicken is almost cooked through.
Add the carrots, potatoes, corn and oregano and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cook for 8 minutes, until all the vegetables are tender and the chicken is cooked to 75C in the thickest part.
Serve with a scoop of rice, coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the juices run clear and the centre reaches 75°C. Wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.
Remove the chicken skin before serving for a lighter soup.

recipes.title: Mexican Guajillo Tortilla Breakfast with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Crisp tortilla triangles tossed in a smoky red chilli sauce, topped with a runny egg, crema, onion and queso fresco.
steps: Soak the guajillo chillies in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain and blend with the tomatoes, garlic, onion, water and salt until smooth.
Fry the tortilla wedges in 3 tbsp oil in batches for 3 minutes, until crisp and golden, and drain on paper.
Simmer the sauce in the same pan for 5 minutes, until slightly thick.
Fold in the tortilla wedges for 1 minute, so they soften at the edges but keep some crunch.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set, then top the chilaquiles with eggs, sour cream, cheese, onion and coriander.
notes: Food safety: eggs are cooked until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Serve at once, as the chips soften quickly.

recipes.title: Mexican Chilaquiles Verdes with Shredded Chicken
recipes.summary: Crisp tortilla chips in a tangy green tomato and chilli sauce with shredded chicken and soft cheese.
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for 15 minutes, until cooked through with no pink inside, then shred it and keep the stock.
Boil the green tomatoes, chillies and garlic in water for 8 minutes, until soft, then blend with the onion, coriander and salt.
Fry the tortilla wedges in oil in batches for 3 minutes, until crisp, and drain.
Simmer the green sauce with 100ml of the chicken stock for 5 minutes in a wide pan.
Fold in the chips and chicken for 1 minute, then serve topped with cheese, sour cream and avocado.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear, wash hands and boards after handling it, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.
Keep extra stock to loosen the sauce if it thickens too much.

recipes.title: Mexican Lime Chicken Soup with Fried Tortilla Strips
recipes.summary: A Yucatecan-style soup of shredded chicken in a fragrant lime broth, finished with crisp tortilla strips and avocado.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pot and cook the onion, garlic and capsicum for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and cumin and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the stock, add the chicken and salt, and simmer for 18 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot with the lime juice and lime slices.
Fry the tortilla strips in the remaining oil for 2 minutes until crisp, and serve the soup topped with strips, avocado and coriander.
notes: Food safety: simmer chicken until the centre reaches 75°C and no pink remains; chill leftovers within 2 hours and reheat until steaming hot.
Add the lime juice at the end so the broth stays fresh and not bitter.

recipes.title: Mexican Crema de Poblano Creamy Roast Chilli Soup
recipes.summary: Charred poblano chillies blended with potato, corn and cream into a velvety, mildly spicy soup.
steps: Char the poblanos over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 10 minutes, turning, until blackened, then cover for 10 minutes to steam, peel and remove the seeds.
Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the potato, stock and salt and simmer for 12 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Blend with the poblanos and half the corn until silky, then stir in the cream and heat gently.
Serve with the remaining corn, a dollop of sour cream and coriander.
notes: Do not rinse the charred chillies under water, as it washes away the smoky flavour.
The soup thickens as it cools, so loosen with stock.

recipes.title: German Kartoffelsalat Swabian Warm Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Warm waxy potatoes dressed in a tangy broth, vinegar and mustard dressing with onion, in the south German style.
steps: Boil the potatoes whole in salted water for 18 minutes, until a knife slides in easily, then drain and peel while hot.
Slice the warm potatoes into thin rounds in a large bowl.
Whisk the hot stock with the vinegar, mustard, oil, salt and pepper, and stir in the onion.
Pour over the potatoes and fold gently, then rest for 10 minutes so they soak up the dressing.
Fold in the chives and pickles just before serving.
notes: Dress the potatoes while warm, as cooled ones will not absorb the dressing.
It is lovely at room temperature and keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Greek Patatosalata Lemon and Oregano Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Tender potatoes with spring onion, parsley, capers and olives, dressed with olive oil, lemon and dried oregano.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes, until just tender, then drain well.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Toss the warm potatoes in the dressing so they absorb it.
Fold in the spring onions, parsley, capers and olives.
Rest for 10 minutes, then taste and add more lemon if needed.
notes: Serve with grilled fish or as part of a meze table.
Keep for up to 2 days in the fridge and bring to room temperature before serving.

recipes.title: French Salade de Pommes de Terre Dijon Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Warm new potatoes tossed in white wine, Dijon vinaigrette with shallot, tarragon and cornichons.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes, until tender, then drain and halve while still warm.
Sprinkle the wine over the hot potatoes and leave for 5 minutes to soak in.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, oil, salt and pepper into a vinaigrette.
Toss the potatoes with the vinaigrette, shallots and cornichons.
Fold through the herbs before serving.
notes: Dress the potatoes warm for the best flavour.
Serve with roast chicken or a poached egg for lunch.

recipes.title: Portuguese Salada de Batata Potato, Egg and Olive Salad
recipes.summary: Chunky boiled potatoes with hard-boiled egg, onion, parsley and olives in a garlicky olive oil and vinegar dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Boil the eggs in a separate pan for 9 minutes until hard-set, cool in cold water, peel and quarter.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, garlic and salt together.
Toss the warm potatoes with the dressing and onion.
Fold in the parsley, olives and eggs gently so the yolks stay intact.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for at least 9 minutes until the yolk is fully set, and keep the salad chilled; eat within 2 days.
Soak the sliced onion in cold water for 5 minutes for a milder bite.

recipes.title: Peruvian Ensalada Rusa Potato and Beetroot Salad
recipes.summary: A creamy, ruby-pink Peruvian-style potato salad with beetroot, carrot, peas and mayonnaise.
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots in salted water for 10 minutes, add the peas for 2 minutes, then drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until hard-set, cool, peel and chop.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold the cooled potatoes, carrots, peas and eggs into the dressing.
Gently add the beetroot last so the colour does not bleed too much, then top with parsley.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set, keep the salad refrigerated, and eat within 2 days.
Cool the potatoes completely before adding the mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Chinese Shredded Ginger Soy Vinegar Dip
recipes.summary: A sharp, savoury dip of Chinkiang black vinegar, soy and fresh ginger threads for any dumpling.
steps: Stir the sugar into the vinegar and soy sauce until it dissolves.
Add the ginger, garlic, sesame oil and chilli oil.
Rest for 5 minutes, then serve in small dishes alongside the dumplings.
notes: Rest is optional, but the ginger mellows the vinegar.
Keeps for 3 days in a jar in the fridge.

recipes.title: Nepali Jhol Achar Sesame and Tomato Dumpling Sauce
recipes.summary: The thin, tangy sesame and roast tomato sauce served with momo, spiced with pepper, cumin and coriander.
steps: Roast the tomatoes and chillies under a hot grill for 10 minutes, turning, until blistered and soft.
Toast the sesame seeds and peanuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden.
Blend the tomatoes, chillies, sesame, peanuts, garlic, ginger, cumin and pepper with the water into a loose sauce.
Heat the oil in a small pan and cook the sauce for 3 minutes, then stir in the lemon juice, salt and coriander.
Serve warm or cool with dumplings.
notes: Thin with water until it pours like a light soup, as the sauce is meant to be runny.
Keeps for 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Spiced Butter Bean Breakfast Mash
recipes.summary: Mashed butter beans simmered with garlic, cumin and chilli, finished with olive oil, tomato and green chilli.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp oil in a pot and cook the garlic and chilli flakes for 1 minute.
Add the beans, cumin, salt and 100ml water and simmer for 8 minutes, until hot and soft.
Mash roughly with a fork, leaving some beans whole.
Stir in the lemon juice and spoon into bowls.
Top with tomato, onion, green chilli and the remaining oil, and serve with bread.
notes: Serve with a hard-boiled egg on the side if you like.
Drain and rinse the beans to cut the tinned flavour.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Chechebsa Spiced Flatbread Scramble
recipes.summary: Torn flatbread fried in spiced clarified butter until crisp at the edges, served with honey or yoghurt.
steps: Melt the ghee in a wide pan over medium heat and stir in the paprika, cayenne, cardamom, ginger and salt for 1 minute.
Add the torn flatbread and toss to coat evenly.
Fry for 8 minutes, stirring, until the pieces are crisp at the edges and chewy in the middle.
Serve warm with yoghurt and a drizzle of honey for dipping.
notes: Use less cayenne for a milder version.
Eat straight away while it is still crisp.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Enkulal Firfir Spiced Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Soft eggs scrambled with tomato, onion, green chilli and spiced butter, a classic Ethiopian morning plate.
steps: Melt the ghee in a pan and cook the onion and chilli for 4 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomato and turmeric and cook for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pour into the pan and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes until just set.
Scatter with coriander and serve with the bread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm with no liquid egg left, particularly for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Add a pinch of cayenne for more heat.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Kinche Spiced Cracked Wheat Porridge
recipes.summary: Cracked wheat simmered until tender then finished with spiced butter, a savoury or sweet Ethiopian breakfast.
steps: Bring the water and salt to the boil, until bubbling, and stir in the bulgur.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and thick.
Melt the ghee with the cardamom, cumin and pepper in a small pan for 1 minute.
Spoon the porridge into bowls, pour over the spiced ghee and top with yoghurt.
notes: Add a spoon of honey for a sweet version.
Add more water if the porridge thickens as it stands.

recipes.title: Argentinian Salsa Criolla Onion, Tomato and Pepper Relish
recipes.summary: A fresh relish of red onion, tomato and capsicum in vinegar and oil, served with grilled meats and choripan.
steps: Mix the onion, tomato, capsicum, garlic and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the vinegar, oil, oregano and salt, and pour over.
Stir and rest for 20 minutes, until the onion softens and the juices pool.
notes: Spoon over grilled meat or bread.
Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Peruvian Salsa Huancaina Creamy Yellow Chilli Cheese Sauce
recipes.summary: A silky, mildly spicy sauce of aji amarillo and fresh cheese, served over boiled potatoes and egg.
steps: Blend the aji amarillo, queso fresco, crackers, evaporated milk, oil, garlic and salt until smooth and thick.
Taste and add salt or a splash of milk to loosen.
Arrange the sliced potatoes on a plate and spoon over the sauce.
Garnish with halved hard-boiled eggs and olives.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for at least 9 minutes until fully set, and keep the sauce chilled; eat within 2 days.
The sauce also suits pasta or grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Peruvian Aji Verde Green Chilli and Coriander Sauce
recipes.summary: The bright green sauce served with roast chicken, made with jalapeno, coriander, lime and mayonnaise.
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth and pale green.
Taste and add more lime or salt as needed.
Chill for 20 minutes before serving.
notes: Serve with roast chicken, grilled vegetables or chips.
Keeps for 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Italian Pearl Barley Salad with Roast Tomatoes and Rocket
recipes.summary: Nutty pearl barley tossed with sweet roast cherry tomatoes, rocket, olives and a lemon dressing.
steps: Roast the tomatoes with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt at 200C for 20 minutes, until collapsing.
Boil the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, until chewy, and drain.
Whisk the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Toss the warm barley with the dressing.
Fold in the tomatoes, rocket, olives and basil.
notes: Add crumbled feta for a salty finish.
Keeps for 2 days in the fridge, without the rocket.

recipes.title: Italian Insalata di Orzo with Lemon, Peas and Mint
recipes.summary: Pasta shaped like rice tossed with peas, lemon, mint and olive oil for a light summer lunch.
steps: Boil the orzo in salted water for 8 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain and rinse briefly.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden.
Whisk the oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toss the warm orzo and peas with the dressing.
Fold in the mint, parsley, spring onions and pine nuts.
notes: Serve cool or at room temperature.
Add flaked tuna or cooked chicken for a main meal.

recipes.title: Lebanese Sumac Bulgur Salad with Walnuts
recipes.summary: Nutty bulgur with pomegranate seeds, parsley, mint and walnuts in a sumac and lemon dressing.
steps: Simmer the bulgur in salted water for 12 minutes, until tender but chewy, then drain.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, sumac and salt.
Toss the warm bulgur with the dressing and leave to cool for 10 minutes.
Fold in the herbs, onion, walnuts and pomegranate seeds.
notes: Serve with grilled lamb or chicken, or as part of a mezze spread.
Add the pomegranate just before serving to keep it fresh.
